glossEn: make known; make an announcement / announce publicly or officially
note: make known; make an announcement / announce publicly or officially。**本词第一义，但现有中文里没有**。线索：announce a decision / officially announce。两条边界只差「公开/正式」的程度，中文不区分，合并。
give the names of。宾语是人名或名单。线索：announce the winners / the results / a list。现有中文无此义项，属新增。
foreshadow or presage。线索：The clouds announced a storm. 现有中文无对应英文边界之外的差别，走 fromZh 接住。
